summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing routine weekly updates on its at-the-market equity program and bitcoin treasury. For September 21–27, 2026, the company sold 1,469,165 Class A common shares for $246.2 million net proceeds, deploying $142.7 million into 1,665 BTC at an average $85,681 and $103.5 million to repurchase STRC preferred under its digital credit securities repurchase program. Holdings reached 847,666 BTC at a $63.95 billion aggregate cost, averaging $75,437. Approximately $18.84 billion remains available for future issuance. No board recommendation or advisor is named; watch continued ATM dilution and preferred buyback cadence.
